patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lightspeed Retail and Magento share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Lightspeed Retail only if your buying job matches “Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD; Lightspe” rather than Magento's shape. Choose Magento only if your buying job matches “Open-source Magento core (free) plus Adobe Commerce enterprise licenses (GMV quote) — deep” rather than Lightspeed Retail's shape. Workflow advantage: Lightspeed Retail leans omnichannel-retail; Magento leans catalog-management, wholesale-b2b. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lightspeed Retail and Magento share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Lightspeed Retail is Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD; Lightspeed Payments ~1.5% card-present; eCommerce on highe; Magento is Open-source Magento core (free) plus Adobe Commerce enterprise licenses (GMV quote) — deep catalog/B2B with high hosting and agency TCO..
- Company-size focus: Lightspeed Retail (small-business, mid-market) vs Magento (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Lightspeed Retail-leaning omnichannel-retail vs Magento-leaning catalog-management, wholesale-b2b, order-fulfillment.
- Researched limits: Lightspeed Retail — No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path; Magento — Operational and agency TCO is high versus hosted SaaS even when the Open Source license is $0.

Limitations — Lightspeed Retail: No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path; Third-party payment processors may incur a high monthly surcharge versus Lightspeed Payments (~1.5% card-present) — confirm live; Magento: Operational and agency TCO is high versus hosted SaaS even when the Open Source license is $0; Adobe Commerce pricing is opaque (GMV quote) — hard to compare without a partner worksheet.

Poor-fit cases: Lightspeed Retail is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path · Magento is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Operational and agency TCO is high versus hosted SaaS even when the Open Source license is $0 · Avoid Lightspeed Retail if you actually need Magento's motion (Open-source Magento core (free) plus Adobe Commerce enterprise licenses (GMV quo)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
